title: The Indiana Fever are hiring Sheri Sam as assistant …
text:
The Indiana Fever are hiring Sheri Sam as assistant … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS The Indiana Fever are hiring Sheri Sam as assistant …
 HoopsHype Oct. 30, 2026, 2:54 p.m. ET The Indiana Fever are hiring Sheri Sam as assistant general manager, focusing on scouting and analytics, sources told IndyStar on Friday afternoon. She will begin her role Monday. There is still no specific timeline for the Fever to hire a general manager. Sam is coming to the Fever from the Portland Trail Blazers , where she was the scouting manager focusing on player evaluation and pre-draft scouting.
